resumeText:
Nikhil Hegde | Bengaluru | nikhil.hegde@example.com | github.com/nikhil-ops

EDUCATION
B.E. Information Science and Engineering, BMS College of Engineering, Bengaluru, 2026 | CGPA 8.0/10

INTERNSHIPS
DevOps Intern, Cubbon Cloud Works Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru | Jan 2026 - Apr 2026 (12 weeks)
- Wrote Bash scripts to rotate application logs and clean old builds on Ubuntu servers.
- Built a GitHub Actions workflow that runs tests and pushes Docker images on every merge.
- Wrote Dockerfiles for a Node.js API and a React front end and ran them together with Docker Compose.
- Launched EC2 instances and S3 buckets on AWS for the staging environment under guidance.
- Wrote a Python script that reports unused EBS volumes to the team every Monday.

Linux Support Intern, Netrix IT Services, Bengaluru | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Created user accounts and fixed file permissions on lab Linux machines.

PROJECTS
- Portfolio site pipeline: Deployed a personal site to EC2 with a Jenkins job triggered by Git pushes.
- Kubernetes practice: Ran a three-service demo app on minikube following an online course.
- Network lab: Set up a small LAN in Cisco Packet Tracer for the Computer Networks course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, 2025

SKILLS
Linux, Bash, Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, S3), Kubernetes (basics), Terraform (basics), Python, DNS and TCP/IP

ACTIVITIES
- Core member, college open-source club; ran a Git workshop for 100 juniors.
